name: ajaia-docs
description: Deployment entry point. client/ and server/ are separate projects; these scripts build the client and start the API serving it on one origin.

scripts.build: npm --prefix client ci --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server ci --omit=dev
scripts.start: cd server && NODE_ENV=production CLIENT_DIST=../client/dist node src/server.js
